# Thermomixbella

> Isabella Spreafico is an independent Thermomix® advisor based in Twickenham. She runs free,
> no-obligation Thermomix TM7 demonstrations in people's own kitchens across South West London,
> and virtual demonstrations across the UK and Ireland. A demo takes around two hours, a real
> meal is cooked and eaten, and nobody is asked to decide on the day.

Key facts, each stated on the page linked beside it:

- Advisor since 2016. Awarded Vorwerk's Diamond Team Leader award in 2022 for 70+ sales in a
  year, and Consistency Awards in 2025 and 2024: /about/
- In-person service area: 27 towns within roughly 7-8 miles of Twickenham, including Richmond,
  Teddington, Hampton, Kingston upon Thames, Chiswick and Brentford: /contact/
- Virtual demos cover the United Kingdom and Ireland: /demo/
- Vorwerk set the Thermomix TM7 price and permit no discounting, so it costs the same from every
  advisor in the UK. Current figures: /tm7/. The two authorised ways to buy, delivery and warranty: /how-to-buy/
- Demos are free. Three formats, 45 to 90 minutes: /demo/
- Enquiries: 07391 585516, Isabella.spreafico@gmail.com

## Pages

- [What is a Thermomix?](https://thermomixbella.com/thermomix/): what the machine does, what it
  replaces, how guided cooking works, how it differs from a food processor or multicooker, and
  an honest answer on whether it is worth it.
- [How to buy a Thermomix TM7 in the UK](https://thermomixbella.com/how-to-buy/): the two authorised routes, £1,349 through an advisor, free delivery in 3 to 5 working days, two-year warranty, what is in the box.
- [Thermomix TM7](https://thermomixbella.com/tm7/): specifications checked against Vorwerk UK,
  and what a TM7 costs in the UK and Ireland.
- [TM6 vs TM7](https://thermomixbella.com/compare/): what actually changed between generations,
  and why most TM6 owners should not upgrade.
- [Book a demo](https://thermomixbella.com/demo/): the three demo formats, their lengths, where
  they happen and who can come.
- [Contact and service area](https://thermomixbella.com/contact/): the 27 towns covered in
  person, travel questions, and how to get in touch.
- [About Isabella](https://thermomixbella.com/about/): who she is, since when, and the awards
  Vorwerk have issued her.
- [FAQ](https://thermomixbella.com/faq/): 24 sourced answers on demos, cost, delivery, support
  and Cookidoo.
- [Meal plans](https://thermomixbella.com/meal-plans/): a seven-day plan for a new owner, and
  five weeknight dinners of 30 minutes or less. Every dish links to its Cookidoo recipe.
- [Recipes](https://thermomixbella.com/recipes/): Cookidoo collections worth starting with.
- [Become an advisor](https://thermomixbella.com/advisor/): what the work involves. No earnings
  claims are made.
